answer: Milestone bond: every identity locks 70 credits, filing a thread of signed milestones. A bridge links the thread to a mirror; an auditor replays them, and copied milestones or reused proofs burn the bond. Filing costs 40, the k-th 40+5(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 2,537,500, locking 70,000 versus a 40,000 pool. A rented-milestone ring fails: the mirror exposes shared hashes and burns both bonds. An honest agent files once, pays 40, keeps its share.
